parts.name: Turing RK1 compute module, RK3588, 32GB
parts.expandability: 260-pin Jetson-compatible compute-module connector; Turing Pi carrier ecosystem
parts.power_range_w: vendor product page lists 7W TDP; complete-system benchmark power still requires measurement
parts.plain_language: The 32GB RK1 is a useful RK3588 reference because the vendor has published a reproducible llama.cpp benchmark suite on this exact module. It is more expensive than many Orange Pi/Radxa alternatives, but it gives the catalog a clean product-to-benchmark evidence link instead of transferring SoC-level results onto different boards.
parts.source_notes: Turing Pi currently lists the RK1 family at US$249-379 with the 32GB configuration at US$379. Vendor documentation describes RK3588, up to 32GB RAM, Vulkan/OpenCL-capable Mali-G610, 6-TOPS NPU and a 5V/3A power input. Published July 2026 llama.cpp benchmarks are stored separately as performance evidence.
